channel.title: The Colorado Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: Jared Polis taps Judge Susan Blanco to serve on Colorado Supreme Court
item.description: Blanco beat out two other finalists — District Judge Christopher Zenisek and Solicitor General Andrea Wang — for the vacancy left by the resignation of Justice Melissa Hart in December

item.title: 5 killed, 29 injured in 36-vehicle pileup on Interstate 25 near Pueblo
item.description: The Colorado State Patrol urged drivers to avoid driving until conditions improved, citing low visibility. The cause of the crash is under investigation.

item.title: Palantir departs Denver, moves headquarters to Miami
item.description: Valued at $300B, Palantir was the largest publicly traded company in Colorado. CEO Alex Karp recently bought a monastery in Old Snowmass.

item.title: Wind-driven wildfires prompt evacuations on Colorado’s Eastern Plains
item.description: Firefighters worked to control the flames as strong winds pushed across dry land in eastern Colorado

item.title: Democrats would be favored to flip 3 Colorado congressional seats under new redistricting proposal
item.description: The proposal, brought by an organization called Coloradans for a Level Playing Field, would ask voters to temporarily override the independent redistricting process that they enshrined in the constitution less than a decade ago

item.title: Littwin: Voting to join the mid-cycle redistricting wars is now a no-brainer
item.description: A group called Coloradans for Leveling the Playing Field has filed to put a redistricting initiative for 2028 and 2030 on November ballot

item.title: Colorado Democrats want to protect the civil rights of students with disabilities
item.description: Legislation in the works would task the state education department with investigating complaints of schools falling short in serving kids with 504 plans, which allow for modifications in the classroom

item.title: Lake Powell forecast to reach critical lows, threatening hydropower generation
item.description: The most dire outlook from the Bureau of Reclamation anticipates water flowing into the massive reservoir at only 37% of a 30-year average

item.title: Avalanche hazard spikes across Colorado as biggest snowstorms of the season land this week
item.description: The Colorado Avalanche Information Center is warning of increased avalanche danger in the northern, central and southern mountains as new snow and high winds bury a weak snowpack

item.title: Colorado State University named a finalist to be the system’s next chancellor. To some, the search was a sham.
item.description: Campus organizations say they don’t want to diminish the qualifications of sole finalist Rico Munn, but think the process should have looked beyond internal candidates
